reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 11 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face/collar crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The dark navy peaked cap retains a shiny black visor, gold cord/piping and two vertically separated gold front emblems. Hair remains covered, dark eyebrows are present, and the face has one stern closed mouth with a smooth chin and no glasses, moustache or beard. The strictly frontal upright pose, direct gaze, squared shoulders, chest-up crop and soft frontal-left light with strong visor shadow remain. The dark navy jacket, gold shoulder/sleeve accents, white pointed shirt collar and dark tie remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted frame, opaque pale warm grey/greige backing, overlapping cream note with two compact upper gray-mark rows and largely blank lower paper, and right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Precise cap embroidery, small gold uniform details, note lettering and the source's barely visible short sideburn edge are not reliably separable at 65x67. These fine uncertainties are not rejection reasons; visible colors, placements, counts and the two-row note footprint were checked.
